topic: Writing a Summary of a Problem-Solution Essay(为问题—解决型短文写摘要)
title_en: Summarising 'Rational People Think at the Margin'
genre: 摘要写作 summary(读懂一篇经济短文,用自己的话概括其核心)
source: 上外版选择性必修四 Unit 2 Writing: writing a summary of a problem-solution essay(范文 'Rational People Think at the Margin')。Writing Strategy: 用同义词与不同句型改写,避免照抄。
prompt_cn: 阅读短文 'Rational People Think at the Margin',用英语写一篇不超过60词的摘要。要求:① 抓住核心观点(生活中的决策多为'边际'上的小调整);② 说清判断方法(比较多走一步的额外收益与额外成本);③ 用自己的话改写、不照抄原句、句型多样。
prompt_en: Read the essay 'Rational People Think at the Margin' and write a summary of no more than 60 words. Capture the main idea (most real-life decisions are small steps 'at the margin'), state how to judge such a step (compare its extra benefit with its extra cost), and use your own words rather than copying the original sentences.
points: 抓核心:决策多是边际上的小调整,不是非此即彼
讲方法:比较多走一步的额外收益与额外成本
下结论:额外收益大于额外成本才行动
用同义改写、句型多样、控制在60词内
model_essay: Most real-life decisions are not all-or-nothing choices but small steps that economists call marginal changes. To choose wisely, we should compare the extra benefit of one more step with its extra cost. A rational person takes an action only when that added benefit outweighs the added cost. In short, thinking at the margin helps people make better everyday decisions.
model_translation: 现实中的大多数决策并非非此即彼,而是经济学家所说的'边际'小调整。为明智地选择,我们应比较多走一步的额外收益与额外成本。理性的人只有在额外收益大于额外成本时才会行动。简言之,边际思考能帮助人们在日常生活中做出更好的决定。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:边际小调整的核心 / 比较额外收益与额外成本的方法 / 收益大于成本才行动
概括完整、逻辑清晰、句句围绕原文核心、不超60词
同义改写到位、句型多样、非谓语等运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 核心:Most decisions are small steps called marginal changes.
方法:Compare the extra benefit of one more step with its extra cost.
结论:Act only when the added benefit outweighs the added cost.
收束:Thinking at the margin helps people decide better.
key_expressions: marginal changes / thinking at the margin
compare the extra benefit with the extra cost
take an action only when the benefit outweighs the cost

high_sentences: Most real-life decisions are small steps that economists call marginal changes.
We should compare the extra benefit of one more step with its extra cost.
A rational person acts only when the added benefit outweighs the added cost.
Thinking at the margin helps people make better everyday decisions.

error_pairs.wrong: The essay tells about how to decide.
error_pairs.correct: The essay explains how to make decisions.
error_pairs.note: 摘要用 explain/describe 等更书面的概括动词,避免口语 tell about。

error_pairs.wrong: Compare the benefit with the cost is important.
error_pairs.correct: Comparing the benefit with the cost is important.
error_pairs.note: 句首作主语用动名词 Comparing,不能用动词原形。

error_pairs.wrong: People should act when the benefit is more bigger than the cost.
error_pairs.correct: People should act when the benefit is bigger than the cost.
error_pairs.note: bigger 已是比较级,不再加 more。

第3句 结论:Act only when the added benefit outweighs the added cost.
第4句 收束:Thinking at the margin helps people decide better.
